judged_text: The permission gate computes isTeamAdminOrOwner as `isTeamAdmin(...) && isTeamOwner(...)`, requiring the caller to be BOTH admin and owner instead of either. A team admin who is not the owner, adding guests to their team's booking, receives FORBIDDEN even though the PR's own variable name and intent state admin-or-owner should be allowed; conversely the gate silently grants nothing to plain admins — the authorization check does not match its stated invariant.

adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed as `(await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...))`, which requires the user to be both a team admin and the team owner. Given the variable name and the surrounding permission gate (`if (!isTeamAdminOrOwner && !isOrganizer && !isAttendee) FORBIDDEN`), this incorrectly denies access to admins who are not owners, contradicting the intended “admin-or-owner” authorization.
